user.title: Sinopec Oil Price
user.description: Select the default province/region for oil price lookup (provinces with price areas continue to area selection).

area.title: Select price area
area.description: This province publishes prices per price area. Each option shows the official coverage (cities/prefectures) and reference prices — pick the one matching your location.

vehicle.title: Add first vehicle (optional)
vehicle.description: Configure a vehicle for {province} to start logging refuels. You can skip and add later in options.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Sinopec oil price website. Try again later.
error.invalid_data: The oil price website returned invalid data.

abort.already_configured: This province is already configured. Edit the existing entry instead.

menu_options.clear_vehicle: 🧹 Clear refuel records of a vehicle

settings.title: Location & refresh settings
settings.description: Change the oil price location or refresh frequency.

area.title: Select price area
area.description: This province publishes prices per price area. Each option shows the official coverage (cities/prefectures) and reference prices — pick the one matching your location.

edit_vehicle_select.title: Select vehicle to edit
edit_vehicle_select.description: Pick a vehicle to modify its initial odometer and default fuel type.

remove_vehicle.title: Remove vehicle
remove_vehicle.description: This will delete the vehicle with all its refuel records and statistics entities.

clear_vehicle.title: Clear refuel records
clear_vehicle.description: Clear all refuel records of the vehicle (vehicle is kept); statistics will be recalculated.

manage_records_select.title: Manage refuel records
manage_records_select.description: Pick a vehicle to list all of its refuel records; you can then delete single records.

manage_records.title: Manage refuel records
manage_records.description: Vehicle: {vehicle} ({count} records). Pick a record to delete. To modify a record, use the edit_refuel_record service.

error.invalid_data: The oil price website returned invalid data.

abort.province_in_use: This province is already used by another entry.
